definitions.explanation: The price of a single item or unit.

examples.japanese: {単価|たんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧{単価|たんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think of strategies to increase customer spending.
The unit price is 200 yen each.

notes:
{単価|たんか} refers to the price of a single unit or item. It is primarily used in business, retail, and manufacturing contexts rather than everyday conversation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧{単価|たんか}: average spending per customer (a key retail metric)
- {単価|たんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧: high/low unit price
- {単価|たんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧/⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to raise/lower the unit price
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧{単価|たんか}: unit cost (manufacturing)

ETYMOLOGY:
{単|たん} (single) + {価|か} (price). Related terms include ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧ (list price), ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧ (cost price), and ⟦{時価|じか}→時価：12969_jika⟧ (market price).

USAGE:
In business discussions, ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧{単価|たんか} (customer unit price) is a key performance metric meaning the average amount each customer spends per visit or transaction.
